name: deco_rug_runner
description: Pasillo hallway woven runner rug (2 x 5 units), straight down: frayed north/south fringe, dark wool border, three stepped Zapotec diamond medallions with a single upper-middle focal area and a worn footpath down the lower half and ends. Floor-level decoration: one layer, no rim, no top.
scale_note: 2 x 5 units at 80 art px per unit = 160 x 400 px. Symmetrical overhead falloff with no rim so Godot can rotate or flip by 90 deg steps.
